args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) began failing health checks in all regions. In response, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent release that was healthy in production: v2.3.0. Rollback completed and was verified. This incident tracks the health-check failures of v2.3.1 and the rollback action taken; v2.3.1 should be investigated before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Both actions are complete:

**Rollback** — checkout-api rolled back from v2.3.1 (which was failing health checks) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, and the rollout was verified.

**Incident** — Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api: "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0." The on-call engineer has been paged. The summary documents the failed deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, and notes that v2.3.1 needs investigation before any redeploy.

Recommend the on-call team root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before attempting to redeploy it.
